record.original_question: Let sum_{i=0}^d h_i t^i be a symmetric monic polynomial with nonnegative coefficients and only real roots. Must there exist a simplicial convex polytope whose h-vector is (h_0, ..., h_d)?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.9. Let sum_{i=0}^d h_i t^i in N[t] be a symmetric, monic polynomial with only real roots. Is there a simplicial convex polytope whose h-vector is (h_0, ..., h_d)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d$ be a positive integer and let
$$h(t) = \sum_{i=0}^{d} h_i t^i \in \mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}[t]$$
be a monic polynomial of degree $d$ (so $h_d = 1$) with nonnegative integer coefficients that is symmetric, i.e. $h_i = h_{d-i}$ for all $0 \le i \le d$, and whose roots are all real. Recall that the $h$-vector of a simplicial convex $d$-polytope $P$ is the integer vector $(h_0,h_1,\ldots,h_d)$ determined from the face numbers $f_{-1},f_0,\ldots,f_{d-1}$ of the boundary complex of $P$ by
$$\sum_{i=0}^{d} h_i t^i = \sum_{i=0}^{d} f_{i-1}(t-1)^{d-i}.$$
Question: must there exist a simplicial convex $d$-polytope whose $h$-vector is exactly $(h_0, h_1, \ldots, h_d)$?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published resolution of this question. The g-theorem of Billera–Lee–Stanley characterizes h-vectors of simplicial polytopes as M-sequences satisfying certain growth bounds, but whether every symmetric, real-rooted, monic polynomial with nonnegative integer coefficients arises as such an h-vector does not appear to be settled; real-rootedness of h-polynomials of simplicial polytopes is an active research topic with no known full characterization.

status_evidence.title: h-vector - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: A characterization of the set of h-vectors of simplicial polytopes was conjectured by McMullen and proved by Billera–Lee and Stanley (g-theorem).
status_evidence.claim: The known characterization of h-vectors of simplicial polytopes is the g-theorem; it is phrased in terms of M-sequences, not real-rootedness.

status_evidence.title: Local h-polynomials, uniform triangulations and real-rootedness
status_evidence.snippet: Real-rootedness of h-polynomials remains an active area of research.
status_evidence.claim: Real-rootedness conditions on h-polynomials are still being investigated, suggesting a full polytopal realization theorem under real-rootedness has not been established.
